open_prerequisites: Complete and audit the bounded selection/uncertainty/robustness orchestrator before declaring any candidate; this admission permits only registered development runs, never holdout tuning.
Freeze collector dataset hashes and exact evaluated-code/configuration hashes before each run
Validate holdout coverage only after a champion and access bundle are frozen; do not inspect its strategy results during development
Confirm actual account/product fees and eligibility before funded use; use public conservative fee scenarios for research
authority: Agent-selected research screening defaults under the user instruction to resolve the remaining review items; not user-approved live preferences.

benchmark_resolution.primary: positive absolute growth and at least 2 percentage points annual growth above ETH after costs
benchmark_resolution.defensive: report separately without automatic promotion or changing the capital-growth objective
benchmark_resolution.live_selection: user decision later; no inference of live risk tolerance

budget.cross_sectional_status: 6 slots disabled: no defensible historical panel; no reassignment

exact_utc_boundaries.boundary_units: UTC daily realization intervals; event-time filtering remains required
exact_utc_boundaries.dataset_binding: Existing dates remain planned evaluation windows, not admission of a newly selected USD/USDC dataset. Verify coverage and information contamination before binding data; no strategy returns inspected.

execution.target_intent_policy: Fixed quantities from prior available closes; queued to designated future daily opens; no resting exchange order or cash borrowing; buys resized down for execution-time cash feasibility.

signal_data_source.scope: Development-only private research; no raw redistribution or source-venue fill replication

research_route.source_selection: Select suitable long historical data independently of the proposed execution venue; do not prefer EUR merely for its available history.
research_route.route_status: Research candidate; compare total execution/conversion costs before selecting a final venue or route.
research_route.eur_use: Optional funding or final cash-out conversion; no routine EUR leg in strategy trades.
research_route.eur_reporting: Optional final purchasing-power/withdrawal report, not the trading numeraire.
research_route.source_execution_mismatch: Label longer USD-source experiments as signal/proxy research until execution price basis, volume provenance, spread and USD/USDC differences are assessed. Do not claim they reproduce Bitvavo fills.
research_route.audited_eur_history: Retained historical QA evidence and optional cross-check; not the mandated research or execution route.
research_route.account_fee_model: Candidate Bitvavo Category B entry-tier 0.05% taker per execution; EUR and conversion fees apply only to actually selected EUR legs.
research_route.simulated_funding: Start with owned 0.5 ETH; do not sell/rebuy it if already the target holding.

allocation.rebalance: Sell target reductions before buys; reserve cash and fees; no borrowing, leverage, forced investment or fixed position-count cap
allocation.weight_rule: Each active asset receives 1/N of equity for the preregistered universe size N, with fees reserved; inactive allocations remain cash. For the current two-asset study this is 0.5 each, not a permanent asset/position-count cap.

data_permission_resolution: Do not treat uncertainty about one exchange as a project-wide blocker. Use another suitable source as needed; do not assume every provider permits unrestricted access or redistribution.

dataset_admission.quality: No gaps, valid OHLC/nonnegative volume; fixed limited universe only
dataset_admission.use_boundary: Supported public API, private research, no raw-data redistribution; not an unrestricted commercial-data license
dataset_admission.coverage_binding: Existing development fold dates fit source history. No strategy performance examined before freezing this admission.
